brief: A wall-hung spice rack: at least three bins, hung from keyhole hangers.

requirements.requirement: Wall-hung spice rack with at least three bins
requirements.evidence: Three half-depth bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-half, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-half, bin:2,0,0~hex-bin-half in a linear 3-cell row (pieces 0,0,0; 1,0,0; 2,0,0) providing three compartments for spices.
Three caps cap:0,0,0;*;270 cap:1,0,0;*;270 cap:2,0,0;*;270 with capVariant 1h (keyhole hanger) on the rear face (bearing 270) to wall-mount the assembly.

finish.summary: Built linear 3-cell wall-hung rack with 3 half-depth bins and 3 keyhole-hanger caps (1h) on the back, joints locked. Mesh clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
